questions.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
questions.evidence: Increase or Decrease = consumption for 2013 - consumption for 2012; Percentage of Increase = (Increase or Decrease / consumption for 2013) * 100%; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year
questions.gold_sql: SELECT CAST((SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0))) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)), CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)) , CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
questions.pred_sql: WITH segment_consumption AS (SELECT t1.Segment, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(t2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN t2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(t2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN t2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013 FROM customers AS t1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS t2 ON t1.CustomerID = t2.CustomerID WHERE t1.Currency = 'EUR' AND t1.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND SUBSTRING(t2.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013') GROUP BY t1.Segment), pct AS (SELECT Segment, CAST(cons_2013 - cons_2012 AS REAL) * 100 / cons_2013 AS pct_increase FROM segment_consumption WHERE cons_2013 > 0) SELECT Segment, pct_increase, CASE WHEN pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM pct) THEN 'biggest' WHEN pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase) FROM pct) THEN 'lowest' ELSE NULL END AS role FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC NULLS FIRST

query_plan.target: Percentage of Increase = (consumption for 2013 - consumption for 2012) / consumption for 2013 * 100, per Segment (SME/LAM/KAM) where Currency = EUR, then identify biggest and lowest
